intro: Uncertainty quantification, scientific computing and machine learning for nuclear data are part of the research (see [Research](research.html)). This page collects complementary work in data engineering and data science, where the same habits apply: reproducible pipelines, tests that check the data, stated assumptions and results that can be reproduced.

certification.title: Data and ML Engineering, OpenClassrooms
certification.text: Level 7 qualification (Bac+5, RNCP), followed from 2025 to 2026. The project-based programme covers the full data lifecycle: relational and NoSQL databases, ETL pipelines, containerisation, cloud services, workflow orchestration, streaming and retrieval-augmented generation. The projects below are the ones with a public repository.

projects_note: Each project was completed for a fictional client scenario set by the programme. Descriptions follow the repository documentation.

projects.title: RAG Chatbot for Cultural Event Recommendations
projects.type: Data engineering · Machine learning · RAG · Proof of concept
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented generation proof of concept that recommends cultural events in Paris from live Open Agenda data, so answers are grounded in real listings rather than the general knowledge of a language model.

details.label: Data
details.text: events fetched from the Open Agenda API, cleaned and filtered to the past 12 months in the Paris region

details.label: Method
details.text: one text chunk per event, embedded and indexed for similarity search; a single LangChain chain serves both the Streamlit chatbot and the RAGAS evaluation (30 questions); 25 automated pytest tests

details.label: Scope
details.text: a proof of concept: single-turn, one data source, manual rebuilds

projects.title: Employee Sports Benefits Data Platform
projects.description: An end-to-end pipeline for a fictional company, built to test the feasibility of two employee benefits and to estimate their financial impact: loading and validating HR and activity data, orchestrating the workflow, posting activities to Slack and presenting indicators on a dashboard.

details.label: Data
details.text: simulated employee and activity data (161 employees); commute distances validated with the Google Maps Distance Matrix API

details.label: Method
details.text: Airflow DAGs, a PostgreSQL store, data-quality checks, Superset dashboards and numbered Bash scripts as a manual fallback, all containerised with Docker Compose

details.label: Scope
details.text: a proof of concept; activity data is simulated, not read from a live service

projects.title: Healthcare Data Migration Pipeline
projects.description: A CSV to MongoDB migration for a fictional healthcare provider with scalability problems, with automated cleaning, integrity testing and a containerised deployment, plus a written study of cloud deployment options on AWS.

details.label: Data
details.text: 54,966 medical records after cleaning (55,500 in the source file)

details.label: Method
details.text: seven-step ETL workflow; name standardisation and duplicate removal; memory use reduced by 21% through categorical and datetime types; five integrity tests passing under pytest

details.label: Outcome
details.text: Docker Compose deployment of MongoDB with a web interface for the database, and an AWS comparison of DocumentDB, Atlas, EC2 and ECS

projects.title: EduGlobe Insights: Education Data Analysis
projects.description: An exploratory analysis of World Bank EdStats to judge whether the data can support the international expansion of an online education service for high school and university learners.

details.label: Data
details.text: the five EdStats tables (indicator values, series catalogue, country metadata, country-series links, footnotes), downloaded separately from the World Bank and not included in the repository

details.label: Method
details.text: exploration, cleaning and analysis in three Jupyter notebooks, with the questions of relevance, completeness and reliability of the indicators
